title: observability: token-level metrics + enhanced tracing + dashboards + alert tuning
author: Daniel Rivera
description: This PR adds token-level observability across the serving runtime and control plane, introduces new Grafana dashboards for token-level cost/latency breakdowns, and tunes alert rules to reduce noise while preserving signal for tail latency and cost regressions. Motivation: teams have lacked fine-grained visibility into per-token latency and cost regressions. This makes it easier to debug quality-vs-cost regressions, identify hot prefixes, and correlate tracing spans to token emission. Changes include: 1) runtime telemetry: emit token_emitted_count, token_emit_latency_ms (histogram), and token_cache_hit labels; 2) tracing: add parent/child spans around KV cache lookup and token emission with attributes for model_variant, seq_len, batch_size; 3) metrics aggregation: new Prometheus recording rules for per-route token cost and p95/p99 per-token latency; 4) dashboards: new token-level cost/latency dashboard and an updated service overview with a token-cost heatmap; 5) alert tuning: adjust thresholds and add dynamic baselining for token-cost-per-request and token-emission tail latency; 6) docs/examples: quickstart and dashboard links. Checklist: - [x] runtime instrumentation added - [x] Prometheus rules + recording rules - [x] Grafana dashboard JSONs committed - [x] unit + integration tests for metric labeling - [x] docs updated (observability section) - [x] alert fatigue analysis and tuned thresholds Links: Linear ENG-1423, ENG-1532; related PRs pr-23102 and pr-21780.
